chapters.title: Once upon a time there were…
p: Once upon a time there were two friends, a bear and a duck. They were always together and had many adventures.
One day they were walking through the woods when they spotted something yellow and shiny. It was a luxury! They both wanted to take it, so they started to quarrel.
The arguing got louder and louder until an old owl flew down and said, “Friends don’t quarrel over things. You should share it and not fight.”
The bear and duck thanked the wise old owl. They decided to work together and share the luxury. They enjoyed it and learnt the valuable lesson about sharing that day.

chapters.title: Max was excited He was going…
p: Max was excited. He was going to go outside and see the unusual sky. He looked up and saw the dark clouds and wondered what form the clouds would take. He began to run towards them, but was stopped by his mom.
"No, Max," she said. "It's not safe outside. It's starting to lock."
Max didn't understand what she meant, but he knew she was serious. He saw that his mom had a worried look on her face. He was beginning to understand why he couldn't go outside.

The clouds were now darkening, and the wind was getting stronger. Max knew something bad was coming, and then it happened. Lightning struck and thunder roared. In an instant, the sky had turned from beautiful and unusual to menacing. Max was scared and ran back into the house, but it was too late. The sky had locked them inside.
Max's mom held him tightly, telling him that everything would be alright. But Max knew that nothing would ever be the same.

chapters.title: Billy was feeling happy so he…
p: Billy was feeling happy, so he asked his mom if he could go to the park. She said yes, and he quickly got into his running shoes.
At the park, Billy saw something even better than the slides and swings; a tall gym. Excitedly he ran to the ladder and started to climb. He made it all the way to the top without stopping.
"Be careful, Billy!" his mom called.
But Billy wasn't listening. He wanted to get to the top of the gym. Suddenly he slipped and started to fall!
"Oh no!" he cried.
Billy's mom quickly tried to help, but she was too late. Billy hit the ground with a thud. His mom was sad but relieved that Billy was okay. She helped him back home for a rest.
Billy learned a lesson that day. He never tried to climb the tall gym again.

chapters.title: Once upon a time there was…
p: Once upon a time, there was a small pumpkin. He was very loud and wished to act like all the other pumpkins. One day, he tried to climb the pumpkin patch, but he was always too big, too round and too heavy.
The pumpkin felt so sad that everyone laughed at him, so he started to act differently. He wanted to do something special and make himself proud.

Suddenly, the little pumpkin had an idea! He opened his mouth and screamed as loud as he could. Everyone was very surprised to see a pumpkin making so much noise! And soon, everyone began to laugh once more.

The little pumpkin felt happy he had found a way to act like the others. He realized he should never be ashamed of being different and instead embrace it! This is the lesson the little pumpkin has taught us: it's good to be loud and proud of our differences.

chapters.title: Once upon a time there was…
p: Once upon a time there was a furry bear. The bear was very brave and kept the forest safe. He had sharp claws and used them to protect the birds and bunnies that lived nearby.
One day, the bear was out walking when he saw a baby bird. The bear knew the bird was just learning to fly and very scared, so he decided to help.

The bear held out one of his giant bear fingers and used it to help the bird get back into the nest. The bird was so thankful that it wrapped its tiny wings around the bear's finger and said thank you.
The bear smiled and gave the bird a big hug. He then promised to protect the bird, and all of the other animals, from any danger that might come.
The furry bear kept his promise and stayed in the forest to keep it safe. Whenever the birds and bunnies were scared, the bear was always there to protect them. He was the bravest bear in the forest!

chapters.title: Once there was a bunny called…
p: Once there was a bunny called Fred. He was very happy and always bouncing around his garden. He would jump high and low, left and right. One day he noticed something special in the garden. It was a colourful kite! Fred was so excited. He wanted to touch it and so he jumped up to the kite. He felt the fabric and the strings of the kite and it felt so nice.

Fred wanted to make the kite fly. He ran around the garden as fast as he could, bouncing and waving his arms around. Before long, the kite rose up into the air! Fred leapt and leapt in excitement, watching as the kite flew higher and higher.

When the kite eventually came back down, Fred was so happy. He jumped up and grabbed it, feeling the soft fabric in his hands. His friends the birds and the bees came to look and admire the colourful kite. It was a wonderful day and Fred was so proud that his hard work had paid off.

chapters.title: Once upon a time there was…
p: Once upon a time, there was a strong girl who was getting ready for a big trip. She went to her bedroom and started to pack her things. She put her clothes and some games into her bag. Then she picked up her pass. She saw it was all ready for her trip.
On the day of her trip the girl grabbed her bag, her pass, and headed out the door. She was so excited to start her journey! She walked to the station and got on the train. She felt brave and strong.
The girl's journey took her far away. When she finally reached her destination she was amazed by the beautiful sights! All of her packing had been worth it.
The girl enjoyed her trip and had lots of fun. When she got back home, she unpacked her things and tucked her strong pass safely away.

chapters.title: Once upon a time there was…
p: Once upon a time there was a little girl. She was three years old. She decided to go on an adventure. She grabbed her hat, put it on her head, and started to jog.
She jogged and jogged and then she stopped by a drain. She peeked down the drain and what do you think she saw? A delicious strawberry pie!
The little girl was so excited! She forgot all about her adventure and climbed right down the drain to get the pie. She grabbed the pie, held it tight and then climbed back out of the drain.
She quickly opened the box and bit into the delicious pie. It was so sweet and yummy! She gobbled it all up and felt happy and full.
The little girl was glad she had gone on her adventure, but she was even happier that it had ended with such a delicious treat.

chapters.title: Once upon a time there was…
p: Once upon a time, there was a little girl. She was wearing yellow shoes. One day, she went outside to play. She wanted to have fun, so she decided to slide. She climbed onto the slide and looked down. It looked kind of scary, but she was brave.
The little girl started to slide down the slide. It was fast and she was giggling. Halfway down, she saw something yellow. It was a something fluffy and yellow! She wanted to know what it was.

She got off the slide and ran over. It was a yellow caterpillar! She had never seen one before. It was moving slowly and she thought it was kind of cute. But then, it changed! It turned into a yellow butterfly!

The butterfly flew away and the little girl was scared. But, she knew it was only trying to find a place to sleep. So, she said goodbye and went back to the slide. She was brave enough to slide one more time before it was time to go inside.

chapters.title: Once upon a time there was…
p: Once upon a time, there was a little girl. She had a hand and she used it to walk. She was bored of just walking. She wanted to do something more fun.
One day, her mom told her that she could go to the park. She was so excited to go! She put on her shoes and grabbed her mom's hand. She squealed with joy.
When they arrived, she ran around and had a lot of fun. Then, her mom said "Let's go to the lake." The little girl was confused. She didn't want to walk it, especially since the lake was far away.
Her mom smiled and said, "We can take the car to get there! Would you like that?" The little girl was so excited. She nodded and laughed, "Yes, I would!"
So, the little girl and her mom walked to the car, hopped in and drove to the lake. She was so happy that she wasn't bored anymore. Now, she could have a fun time at the lake.

chapters.title: Jemma was a big girl three…
p: Jemma was a big girl, three years old and very brave. She wanted to play with her friends at the park, but it was all so dirty. Everywhere she looked the grass was mucky and the sand was gritty. But Jemma didn't give in.

Jemma decided to make her own game. She used a stick to mark a goal in the sand. She and her friends took turns taking shots at the goal by throwing pebbles. Jemma cheered every time her friends made a shot.

The game was going well until a big, mean cat came by. It jump over the goal and even tried to take the stick. Jemma had to be brave and take a stand. She clapped her hands and yelled so loud at the cat that it ran away in a fright.

Jemma and her friends cheered. They were so proud of their brave leader. The game was able to continue and the goal was made even stronger. The cat never came back and Jemma was proud of her goal. The game was a success and everyone had great fun.

chapters.title: Jack was at the beach with…
p: Jack was at the beach with his family. He wore his new blue pants but he felt very uncomfortable in them.
He saw a girl in the distance and wanted to meet her, so he waved to get her attention. The girl kept walking and Jack kept waving, but the girl couldn't see him.
He asked his mom why the girl couldn't see him. His mom said it was because of his pants. She said they were so big that they were covering his waving arm.
Jack felt very frustrated, he wanted to play with the girl, but his pants were getting in the way. He asked his mom if he could take them off, but she said no.
Jack was so mad, he wanted to throw a tantrum, so he crossed his arms and started to pout. His mom said it would be ok, she said he just had to try harder to wave with his other arm.
Jack tried to obey his mom and he waved with his other arm. This time the girl saw him and waved back.
Jack felt much better, he was so happy he could finally play with the girl. He felt comfortable and happy again!

chapters.title: Bob was getting ready to go…
p: Bob was getting ready to go to work. He put on his uniform and was getting ready to leave the house. But then he paused. He remembered he had forgotten something very important. He had forgotten his lunch! He felt so stupid.

He quickly got off the uniform and dashed to the kitchen. He quickly packed some lunch and hurried back into the uniform. He paused for a moment, making sure that he had remembered everything for this time. He hadn't forgotten anything else, which made him relieved.

He was now ready for work. As he was about to open the door he paused for one final time. He gave himself a pat on the back for being so smart and remembering his lunch. He smiled and went straight to work. He was confident that today would be a good day.

chapters.title: Once upon a time there was…
p: Once upon a time, there was a farmer. He lived far away, in a distant place. The farmer liked to stop and pause when he worked. He would rest and look around, to take in the sights.
One day, he saw something strange. It was a small, white animal with big ears. He had never seen one before! He paused and watched it, wondering what it was.
Suddenly, it started to hop away. The farmer ran after it, crossing fields and hills. He finally caught up to the animal and paused to look at it. It was a rabbit, and it hopped away again.
The farmer paused to laugh. He was happy to see the rabbit, even if it was far away. He waved goodbye, and the rabbit hopped away into the distant, green fields.

chapters.title: Once upon a time there was…
p: Once upon a time, there was a large ranch. In the ranch, there lived two children: Tom and Susie. One day, Tom and Susie were walking in the ranch. Suddenly, Tom said to Susie, "Let's dance!"
Susie smiled and said, "Yes! That sounds like fun!"
Tom and Susie started dancing around the large ranch. They jumped and twirled in the warm sun. All the animals grazing on the ranch stopped to watch them.
On and on they danced until they were too tired to dance anymore. After a while, Susie said, "That was so much fun! Let's do it again soon!"
Tom smiled and said, "Yes, let's do it! It was a great way to spend the day!"
And that is how Tom and Susie spent their day: dancing in the large ranch!

chapters.title: Once upon a time there was…
p: Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Sarah. She had long brown hair and big blue eyes. Every morning Sarah woke up early and knelt on the ground to say her prayers.

One day, when Sarah got down to pray, she noticed something in the distance. It was a white cow and she was mooing softly. Sarah knew it must have been looking for milk, so she ran inside to grab a bucket.
She filled the bucket and brought it back out. Kneeling down, she carefully poured milk into a saucer next to the cow. The cow was so happy that it mooed louder than ever before!

It was then that Sarah noticed a lady standing further away in the distance. She was wearing a long, white dress, with a big smile on her face. Thank you, Sarah!", the lady said, "That cow and I are very grateful".
Sarah asked who the lady was, but the lady simply smiled and said, "A distant friend". Then she bowed and turned away.
Sarah never saw the mysterious lady again, but every day she would kneel to say her prayers, knowing that she helped a distant friend.

chapters.title: A bunny hopped along the sidewalk…
p: A bunny hopped along the sidewalk until he came to a big billboard. He leaned in to look at it, but was startled when a big, red balloon bounced out of nowhere. The bunny jumped back, feeling scared. He quickly hopped to safety.

Just then, a little girl walked around the corner, clapping her hands. She was very excited when she saw the big, red balloon. She scooped it up with her tiny hands and shouted, "Wheeee! This is so much fun!"
The bunny watched as she bounced the balloon up and down in the air. He laughed and said, "It sure is a lot of fun bouncing a balloon."
The girl smiled and said, "Yes, I love it! I'm so glad we found it."
The bunny nodded, feeling happy to have found something that made the little girl so happy. He said goodbye to the little girl and hopped away, with a big smile on his face.

chapters.title: Once upon a time there were…
p: Once upon a time there were two friends named Bobby and Jimmy. Bobby was a very naughty boy and he liked to buy things. One day, Jimmy told Bobby that he shouldn't buy so many things because he was being naughty.
Bobby didn't want to listen to Jimmy and he kept buying whatever he wanted. This made Jimmy really mad, so he decided to take away all of Bobby's money.
Bobby cried and said he was sorry to Jimmy, and promised to not buy any more things without his friend's permission. Jimmy was happy to hear this and they hugged and made up.
From then on, Bobby and Jimmy would always check with each other before buying anything. They were friends again, and they lived happily ever after!

chapters.title: Once there was a girl who…
p: Once there was a girl who really wanted to go on an adventure. She wanted to explore a stream she had never seen. So, she went with her mom to find it. It was a very quiet stream, with no people around. The girl and her mom sat down by the water and the girl started throwing stones in. She wanted to make little patterns in the water. Suddenly she saw a fish swim up to the surface. The fish wanted to play, too. So the girl and the fish had lots of fun together. Then, after playing for a while, she and her mom went home. She was very happy that she had found a new friend in the quiet stream.

chapters.title: Once upon a time there was…
p: Once upon a time there was a little girl named Sarah. She was only three years old. One day, Sarah decided to go to the garden to pick some radishes.
As Sarah approached the garden, she got a little scared. But she reminded herself that radishes were her favorite vegetable, and so she kept walking.

Once there, she began gathering her vegetables. She filled her basket but then noticed an old, black snake in the corner of the garden. Sarah was very scared and immediately wanted to quit. But then she remembered how much she loved radishes, so she took a deep breath and kept picking.

The snake watched her, but then quietly slithered away. When Sarah was all done, she proudly showed her parents the basket full of radishes. Her parents were so proud of her, and Sarah felt brave and proud too!

chapters.title: Once upon a time there was…
p: Once upon a time, there was a frog called Joe. Joe loved to explore and find new things.
One day, Joe decided to go to the swamp. He was excited to see what was there.
When he arrived, he saw two worms talking to each other. Joe was surprised, and he jumped over to introduce himself.
The worms were very friendly, and they asked him to stay for a while. The three of them talked and laughed together.
Suddenly, it started to rain very heavily. The worms said that Joe had to stay with them and said he should hide in a tight hole. Joe thought it would be ok, so he stayed in the hole.
It kept raining for days and days and soon, Joe was stuck in the tight hole. He was scared and he cried for help, but nobody heard him.
Joe was stuck in the swamp forever and ever.
The end.

chapters.title: Tommy was a smart 3 year…
p: Tommy was a smart 3 year old, much smarter than other children his age. He saw the world in his own special way. When his parents asked him to come with them to the park, he said yes.

As they drove up to the park, Tommy noticed a big camera up in a tree. He asked his parents what it was and why it was there. His dad said, "It's a camera, Tommy. It was put there to take pictures of people in the park."
When Tommy and his parents reached the park, Tommy spotted the camera again. But this time, he noticed something different. He saw people suffering, carrying heavy bags and struggling up the path.

Tommy asked his dad what was going on. His dad smiled sadly and explained, "Those people are suffering because they have to carry heavy things. That camera is here to make sure they're following the rules."
Tommy's dad gave him a hug and said, "You're so smart for understanding this." Tommy realized that the camera was there to help the people in the park, not to make them suffer.

chapters.title: Once upon a time there was…
p: Once upon a time there was a school. All the children were very excited because today the class was getting a new blackboard. The kids rushed to the front of the classroom and eagerly waited for the teacher. She arrived and took her seat behind the big desk.

The teacher smiled and said, "Today, we will write on our new blackboard!" She asked for an erase, but it was too weak. So, she asked one of the children to help. The little girl went to the back of the room and brought a much stronger one.
The teacher smiled and thanked her. Then she asked everyone to get ready. She took a piece of chalk and began writing on the blackboard. Soon, everyone was clapping and having fun.

After the lesson, the children sat down in their seats and began to work on their project. They enjoyed using the blackboard and talked about what a great day it was. Even though the erase was weak, it still did its job. Everyone was so happy that they got the chance to write on the new blackboard!

chapters.title: The sun was setting on a…
p: The sun was setting on a warm summer evening. Sam and Bella were sitting on their porch, discussing their plans for the evening. Sam wanted to stay home and play with his toys, but Bella wanted to do something more adventurous.
"Let's explore the forest," said Bella.
Sam was very excited. "We can climb trees and look for bugs and birds!" he said.

So Sam and Bella put on their shoes and grabbed a flashlight. They opened the door to the forest, and soon they were exploring in the darkness. They heard crickets chirping and the breeze rustling through the trees.

They discovered so many new things. They saw a groundhog and a fox and even an owl! Sam and Bella had the most adventurous and exciting evening. When it was time to go home, they both agreed that exploring the forest was the best idea ever.

chapters.title: Once upon a time there was…
p: Once upon a time, there was a nosy girl named Sarah. She was always pretending to be something in the world of make-believe. One day, she had a great idea! She was going to pretend to be a racecar, driving around as fast as she could. She ran around the backyard, speeding in circles.

The next day, Sarah was ready to pretend racecars again. But this time, she surprised herself when she felt like she was really going faster than before. She couldn't believe it! She was actually going faster than ever before.
Sarah couldn't believe it! It was almost like she had gotten some kind of magical boost of speed. Little did she know that her family had bought her a big-wheeled scooter the night before.

The scooter was the perfect tool for Sarah to pretend she was a racecar. She zipped around the yard, pretending to win races. She was so happy with her newfound speed that she kept pretending for days!
